facts.text: Victoria House is a beach resort on the east side of Ambergris Caye, facing Coconut Drive, the road into nearby San Pedro.
facts.excerpt: Victoria House is a beautiful beach resort on the east side of Ambergris Caye. We face Coconut Drive which is the road that takes you into nearby San Pedro.

facts.text: Victoria House sits at the edge of the Belize Barrier Reef.
facts.excerpt: perched right at the edge of one of the most stunning natural wonders of the world, the Belize Barrier Reef

facts.text: A tropical buffer separates the road from the resort's rooms, villas and casitas, which all face the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: a tropical buffer lays between the roadway and our blend of luxury staterooms, villas, Palmetto Rooms and casitas, which all face the magnificent Caribbean Sea

facts.text: The resort has outdoor infinity-edged pools and a private beach.
facts.excerpt: outdoor infinity-edged pools and a spectacular private beach

facts.text: The resort has an onsite dive shop and a tour desk.
facts.excerpt: tour desk, onsite dive shop, stunning public gardens, an on-site wedding planner

facts.text: Guests can use the resort's bicycles, kayaks and paddleboards.
facts.excerpt: Stay on site and enjoy our refreshing pools, bicycles, kayaks and paddleboards

facts.text: Excursions include ancient Mayan temples, a zip-line tour over the jungle canopy, rainforest expeditions, fishing trips and diving the Great Blue Hole.
facts.excerpt: Explore ancient Mayan temples, take an exhilarating zip-line tour over the verdant jungle canopy, embark on a rainforest expedition, take a fishing trip or dive the renowned Great Blue Hole.

facts.text: Victoria House won the Conde Nast Johansens award for Best for Romance in 2025.
facts.excerpt: including “Best for Romance” in 2025

facts.text: The casitas have a thatched roof, a queen bed, a private veranda and a hammock.
facts.excerpt: Discover the quintessential tropical casita, complete with a thatched roof, queen bed, private veranda, and your own hammock to relax in.

facts.text: The beachfront villas Casa Playa Blanca and Casa Azul each have their own private pool.
facts.excerpt: Casa Playa Blanca and Casa Azul both have their own private pools.

facts.text: The villas feature locally handcrafted wicker and mahogany furniture and private verandahs with views of the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: All units feature locally hand crafted wicker and mahogany furniture and private verandahs offering stunning views of the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: The Luxury Villas have traditional thatch roofs, mahogany four-poster canopied king beds and travertine bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Each villa offers traditional thatch roofs, mahogany poster king size canopied beds, luxurious travertine bathrooms and more.

facts.text: The Rainforest Suite is the resort's beachfront Honeymoon Suite, with a wraparound veranda, a private hammock and views of the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: This beachfront villa is our Honeymoon Suite and features a king bed, large tiled bathroom, a wraparound veranda with private hammock and stunning views of the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: The one-bedroom Infinity Suites have a gourmet kitchen and three private verandas, including a secluded upper terrace with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a gourmet kitchen and three private verandas, including a secluded upper terrace with incredible ocean views.

facts.text: The spa is called La Luna Spa.
facts.excerpt: La Luna Spa - Victoria House

facts.text: The Victoria House Signature Treatment combines a Coco Body Polish, a warm al fresco shower and a Signature Relaxation Massage.
facts.excerpt: Start with a Coco Body Polish, followed by a warm al-fresco shower, and finish with our Signature Relaxation Massage.

facts.text: The spa offers the Arvigo Maya Abdominal Massage, developed in Belize with a traditional Maya healer.
facts.excerpt: Developed in Belize with a traditional Maya healer, used worldwide, and personally tailored to each individual

facts.text: The spa has Junior Spa Services with treatments for kids.
facts.excerpt: Kids can enjoy their very own treatments created with our Junior Spa Services

facts.text: Palmilla Restaurant is a full-service waterfront restaurant where fresh, local seafood is a specialty.
facts.excerpt: fresh, local seafood being a particular specialty

facts.text: Private candlelit dinners can be held on the pier palapa or at a private beach table lit with tiki torches.
facts.excerpt: dine in the seclusion of either our pier palapa or at your private beach table, lit with tiki torches under the tropical sky

facts.text: Admiral Nelson's is a palapa-style beach bar overlooking the Belize Barrier Reef and the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: is our palapa style beach bar overlooking the Belize Barrier Reef and the Caribbean Sea

facts.text: A complimentary continental breakfast buffet is included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: A complimentary continental breakfast buffet is included in the room rate.

facts.text: Victoria House describes itself as a boutique resort for travelers seeking seclusion and intimacy.
facts.excerpt: Victoria House Resort and Spa is a boutique resort, offering exclusive Belize accommodations for those wondering where to stay in Belize and looking for seclusion and intimacy.

facts.text: Staff can help arrange golf cart rentals, taxis and shuttles.
facts.excerpt: They can also assist with golf cart rentals, taxis and shuttles.

facts.text: Room rates do not include government tax and service charge.
facts.excerpt: Rates are in $USD and do not include 9% government tax & 10% service charge.

facts.text: Private yoga sessions can be arranged through the spa receptionist.
facts.excerpt: Can be arranged with our Spa receptionist

facts.text: The resort calls itself perfect for couples and honeymoons.
facts.excerpt: is absolutely perfect for couples looking to just get away from it all, or a place to spend that perfect honeymoon
